config.quality: All unique decisions once, batches <=8, API-only retries up to 3; invalid output is wrong.
config.load: First up to four preselected packets per task; continuous closed-loop workers, two repeats, C8/C32. Window=max(20s,4*largest calibrated token reservation / token rate), capped at 120s. Same model window at both C levels. No response reuse.
config.pricing: Quality-pass usage per 1000 unique decisions. Flash offpeak/peak bounds. Load replay costs archived separately.
config.limits: Smooth admission within published quotas; Qwen reserves prompt plus max output. Configured concurrency is only a ceiling.
config.shared_patient: 8 hash-selected SIGIR synthetic patients, 8 hash-selected trials each, upstream 0/1/2 gold unchanged. Overlap with existing referral pool possible; not added to overall 26-task mean.
